curatedLibrary.enabledHint: Allow this library's curated folders, playlists, and audio files to sync to the cloud. Analysis, cues, filter/SET/mixtape libraries, and the recycle bin itself are not synced.

The first-alignment dialog appears until this computer joins the cloud library. Fingerprint sync and curated-library sync queue instead of running in parallel.

curatedLibrary.joinLocalHint: The cloud will match this computer. Current cloud content will be replaced.

reset.title: Dangerous: Clear cloud curated library
reset.description: This empties the cloud curated library for the current userKey (folders, playlists, and audio) and frees that quota. If curated sync is still enabled on this computer, local curated tracks are moved to the recycle bin to match the empty cloud. Cloud fingerprints and curated artists are not cleared. IRREVERSIBLE. Type DELETE to continue.
reset.hint: The cloud curated library becomes empty. If sync is still on, this computer's curated library is cleared into the recycle bin too. Cloud fingerprints and curated artists are left untouched.
reset.needUserKey: Save a userKey first, then try this action again.
reset.success: Cloud curated library cleared. If curated sync is on, local curated tracks were moved to the recycle bin.

reset.description: This will delete all cloud fingerprints, curated artist snapshots, and related metadata linked to the current userKey (usage stats are not reset, and curated library audio is not deleted). IRREVERSIBLE. Type DELETE to continue.
